module: Evaluates the player vehicle's parking precision at a delivery's destination (parcel, materials or vehicle) and applies reward bonuses or penalties. The score (2 to 20) combines the angular alignment, the lateral offset and the longitudinal offset of the bounding box center relative to the parking spot; it gives a perfect/great/good/bad/horrible level. The bonuses affect money, logistics XP, skill XP and the organization's reputation.
notes: Score thresholds: perfect >= 20, great >= 15, good >= 10, bad >= 5, otherwise horrible. Score = min(20, (angleScore+sideScore+forwardScore)*6 + 2) rounded, each sub-score being in [0,1].
Angles in degrees, distances in meters. Parking at 180° counts as 0° (adjusted angle = 180 - angle if > 90). Default spot 2.5 m x 5.0 m if width/length are absent.

The tolerances are adaptive: maxSide = max(0.3, (spotWidth - vehicleWidth)*0.3), maxForward = max(0.4, (spotLength - vehicleLength)*0.3); the minimums are 30% of the maximums (floors 0.1 and 0.15). The angle goes from 7.5 deg (0 points) to 1.6 deg (full score).
The 'skill' bonus is added to the same reward key as the 'logistics' bonus ('logistics-vehicleDelivery', 'logistics-materials' or 'logistics-delivery'): both add up on a single entry.
calculateCargoPrecisionScore (internal) ignores its cargo parameter and always uses the player vehicle (be:getPlayerVehicleID(0)).
The amounts are modified in place: calling the main function twice on the same parcel would apply the bonus twice.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the references to parcelManager, general, generator and vehicleTasks.

calculateVehiclePrecisionScore.desc: Computes a vehicle's parking score relative to a spot (position, rotation, optional width and length), following the logic of parkingPointsNode.lua.

targetParkingSpot.desc: Parking spot with pos (vec3), rot (quat) and optionally width, length.

returns.desc: Table with precisionLevel, totalScore, angle, adjustedAngle, sideDist, forwardDist, sub-scores and tolerances; nil if the vehicle cannot be found.

getPrecisionParkingBonus.desc: Converts a precision result into a bonus: fixed amounts and percentages for money (positive or negative), logistics XP, skill XP (good/great/perfect) and reputation (great/perfect bonus, horrible penalty). With no data, returns a zero bonus of level 'none'.

returns.desc: Table with precisionLevel, totalScore, measurements and fields moneyFlat/Percent, logisticsFlat/Percent, skillFlat/Percent, reputationFlat/Percent.

calculateVehiclePrecisionParking.desc: For a vehicle delivery: computes the precision at taskData.dropOffPsPath and adds the bonus to taskData.adjustedRewards, with the detail in taskData.breakdown.precisionParking. Returns taskData unchanged if data is missing.

taskData.desc: Delivery task with dropOffPsPath, vehId, originalRewards, adjustedRewards, breakdown and offer.organization.

calculateCargoPrecisionParking.desc: For a parcel or materials: evaluates the player vehicle at the spot targetLocation.psPath and applies the bonus to cargo.rewards (money, logistics-materials or logistics-delivery, organization reputation); stores the detail in cargo.precisionParking.

targetLocation.desc: Destination containing psPath, the parking spot path.

returns.desc: The parcel, modified if the score could be computed.

getPrecisionParkingConfig.desc: Returns the configuration table (score thresholds and reward amounts/percentages) for the UI or debugging.

debugPrecisionParking.desc: Debug function: returns a vehicle's precision score for a spot (the log is commented out in the code).
